decision: Compare final epoch8 against completed v5 reference epoch8 on identical internal targets. MAE and RMSE must both improve; otherwise stop. No outer refit is launched by this pilot.
scope_note: Only pretraining normalization changes: absolute globally-standardized Wspd is retained consistently with forecasting, and its reconstruction inverse uses mean0/scale1. Forecast preprocessing/power residuals, losses, LR, seed, data labels, split and Wiki thresholds are unchanged. New matched pretraining is necessary, not a repeated run of the old pretrain. Internal selection was previously inspected and this is development evidence, not an untouched confirmation set. No outer validation/test is evaluated.
